finalYaml:
parameters:
- name: groups
  type: object
  default:
  - name: alpha
    vars:
      G: alpha-var
  - name: beta
    vars:
      G: beta-var
stages:
- stage: alpha
  variables:
  - name: G
    value: alpha-var
  jobs:
  - job: probe
    steps:
    - task: CmdLine@2
      inputs:
        script: echo $(G)
- stage: beta
  variables:
  - name: G
    value: beta-var
  jobs:
  - job: probe
    steps:
    - task: CmdLine@2
      inputs:
        script: echo $(G)
